BiblicalUsage: There arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the daily bread of widows is the church's first test, and the murmuring was the sign it was failing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
